profile.timerInterpretation: host wall durations; native work can be charged at nextGeneratedCall, explicit sync or internal materialization; nextGeneratedCall includes suffix prefill, cache batching, decode and implicit waits

nativePhases.interpretation: sum exclusive phase times and separate pre-boundary waits; inclusive parent phases contain child work

measurementLimitations: synchronized host/native method phases, not isolated hardware kernel traces
extra barriers disrupt original asynchronous token lookahead and can increase total wall time
cache concat/filter/split state is explicitly materialized for attribution; fusion/allocation behavior can change
initial empty derived-batch construction adds setup overhead without generating tokens
use paired uninstrumented latency and exact raw-token/EOS parity, never substitute profile wall time for serving latency
